counterfactual_missing_items: no mention of a cystic structure
absence of a clear tract leading to the tongue base
decisive_items: Neck ultrasound failed to identify the thyroid gland in its normal pretracheal location
several adjacent 1 cm nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue, and no thyroid gland was seen in the usual neck location
response.rationale: The presence of ectopic thyroid tissue at the base of the tongue, as suggested by the imaging findings and the absence of a normal thyroid gland in the neck, makes R2 a more likely diagnosis than R1

rejected.why: lack of definitive evidence for a thyroglossal duct cyst
